## Batch040 — independent whole linguistic review

**Verdict: NEEDS_FIX.** Two required corrections and one unsupported safeguard proposal remain. No files were written, tests run, agents launched, or Git/app state changed.

### Snapshot and actual scope

- RU: `89cdaf33c95599edfd59c8d8d18abd0232216bf3`, branch `full-ru-040-connectives-frequency-degree`.
- Frozen EN: `6af98cb717755690a9ca793e5454a96ebd7a8f9f`.
- Actually read **all 25 new and 22 contextual EN/RU pairs**, including complete bodies, Russian prose, Japanese examples/readings, titles and metadata; additionally both complete **EN-only** sources 全然/あんまり. That is **47 pairs plus two EN-only bodies**, not 49 Russian pairs.
- Read **all 756 actual compact captions**, assessing both quiz directions and coarse polysemy—not 756 full lessons.
- Read **all 55 complete captured query-object rows** from the 49 queries, including additional selections. One pure Wikipedia object and appended Wikipedia senses were excluded from lexical evidence.
- Read all **42 proposals**, all five supplementary evidence rows, all 27 link dispositions, and the four serialized author-run check outputs.
- Read the applicable general/scoped instructions, all three reviewer rubrics, methodology/format guidance, frozen word-format section, and confusable-word introduction/CW060/CW064.

Transport verification reconfirmed both snapshots and integrity boundaries. Candidate **1068 runtime / 756 words**, version `ab5ca761105705c0`, is **not acceptance beyond the existing 1043**.

### Required corrections

**R1 — Minor · C1/C3 · `words\まだ.md:34` — incorrect temporal explanation**

> «когда этап наступил раньше, чем ожидалось»

This describes an event occurring ahead of schedule. The source instead describes the **current stage/time being earlier or less advanced than expected**. In `まだ三時です`, three o’clock has not “arrived early”; it is **only three**, rather than a later expected time.

**Consequence:** the explanation can reverse the learner’s model of まだ despite the correct example translation.

**Fix:** for example:

> «когда сейчас более раннее время или менее продвинутая стадия, чем ожидалось»

Preserve the Japanese example and «Ещё только три часа».

**Evidence:** complete frozen EN/RU pair; EN “when a stage is earlier than expected”; captured まだ “still; only” sense. **Confidence: high.**

---

**R2 — Minor · C2 · `words\よく.md:9` — omitted direct caption protections**

The exclusion list covers six quality-related neighbours but misses two independently supported overlaps:

- **よく–多い:** actual captions `часто; хорошо` / `много; многочисленный`. Captured 多い sense 3 explicitly includes **frequent/common**; unchanged `words\多い.md:18` itself teaches `雨が多い` as «часто идут дожди».
- **よく–どうも:** actual captions `часто; хорошо` / `спасибо; очень`. Captured よく sense 3 explicitly expresses appreciative **“thank you for…”**, independently overlapping どうも’s gratitude meaning.

**Consequence:** a contextless written prompt can oppose a defensible coarse Russian answer to the expected answer. Different grammatical behaviour does not itself resolve that caption ambiguity.

**Fix:** add **多い** and **どうも** directly to the new よく exclusion list and record their individual, bounded rationales. No unchanged support-file edit or transitive expansion is needed. These are contextual protections, **not claims of neutral N5 teaching or demonstrated modern frequency/necessity**.

**Evidence:** complete captured よく, 多い and どうも objects; complete support bodies and actual captions. **Confidence: high for the recognized overlaps and missing bindings.**

### Adjudication of the 42 proposals

**All 18 source-sense proposals are supported for the stated captions.** Preserve the four actual source edges:

- いつも–たいてい
- まだ–もっと
- 本当–現実
- 現実–実際

The other 14 have individually supportable leftover, contrast, sequence/addition, repetition/additional-amount, degree or reality/practice caption overlaps. This does **not** make their Japanese uses universally interchangeable.

For the **24 limited proposals**, the following are accepted **only for the expressly bounded protective purpose**:

| Proposals | Supported boundary |
|---|---|
| じゃ–さあ; じゃあ–さあ; では–さあ; それでは–さあ | Shared coarse «ну» for transition/resolve; not all urging, hesitation or farewell uses. |
| そうして–また; そして–また; それから–また | Addition of information/items and «также»; not unrestricted noun coordination or repetition. |
| よく–ゆっくり | «хорошо» for comfortable/good rest or sleep; not frequency versus slowness. |
| よく–上手 | Well/skillfully performed action; morphology remains distinct. |
| よく–いい; よく–良い | Coarse Russian «хорошо» in quality/predicative evaluation; not identical adjective grammar. |
| よく–結構; よく–大丈夫 | Bounded satisfactory/all-right evaluation; not every degree, safety or acceptance use. |
| だんだん–階段 | Recognized 段々 noun “stairs” against «лестница»; no everyday kana-frequency assertion. |
| だんだん–どうも | Exact-kana **Izumo-dialect** gratitude homograph against «спасибо»; not standard-Japanese teaching. |
| 多分–たくさん; 多分–多い | Recognized secondary large-amount sense against «много», independently for each pair. |
| 多分–たいてい | Actual 大抵 “probably” sense against «наверное; вероятно». |
| もう–とても; もう–どうも | Recognized emphatic degree against «очень», independently—not transitively. |
| もう–本当 | Restricted affirmative emphasis corresponding to contextual «правда/действительно»; not truth-noun equivalence. |
| ちょうど–いい | Suitability/just-right against «подходит»; not every merely good thing. |
| もう–さあ | Coarse discourse «ну» only; exasperation and encouragement remain distinct. |

**Not accepted on the present evidence: また–本当**  
**C2 · UNVERIFIED rationale · `words\また.md:9`**

The actual 本当 caption is `правда; настоящий`. また’s captured “really” is explicitly qualified by surprise/shock/doubt. Actual dictionary examples such as `またなんときれいな花だ` express surprised evaluation—not verification of truth or genuineness. English **really** alone therefore does not establish this particular Russian-caption binding.

**Disposition:** withdraw this proposal/current declaration, or supply an actual context demonstrating the proposed Russian overlap for separate assessment. This is not a claim that every imaginable contextual overlap is impossible. **Confidence: high that the present rationale is insufficient.**

Thus: **23/24 limited proposals supported; one not accepted.** For **all 24**, stronger claims of ordinary modern necessity or frequency remain **UNVERIFIED and unasserted**.

The four connector variants’ identical truthful title already provides exact-title deduplication. No redundant six-edge clique is warranted.

### Actual external source verification

- Read Kotobank’s **小学館「プログレッシブ和英中辞典(第4版)」**, もう sections 1–3. Section 2 directly gives bare `もう母も来るでしょう` as **soon**. The bounded taxi explanation is supported; this is not a universal nonpast rule or frequency finding.
- Independently retrieved the official JMdict archive securely and read entries **1505990** and **1427340**: 然し/併し genuinely carry rare-kanji-form annotations; 丁度 carries the phonetic/ateji annotation. The captured API’s omitted annotation fields were not treated as proof.
- Read actual Kotobank また/もう dictionary sections when adjudicating emphatic safeguards. No whole-dictionary or corpus-frequency claim is made.

### Remaining assessment and limits

- **C1:** NEEDS_FIX for R1; no other actionable Japanese defect established in the complete stated scope.
- **C2:** NEEDS_FIX for R2; また–本当 remains unapproved/UNVERIFIED. The 25-word closure, levels **22 N5 + 1 N4 + 2 N3**, and optional-wrapper adaptations are otherwise supported.
- **C3:** NEEDS_FIX for R1. Optional polish: `多分.md:21` mixes «предполагает» with «а не уверенность»; rephrase as «…выражает предположение, что человек не придёт, а не уверенность в его приходе».

The immutable app map confirms five canonical tag IDs lack explicit localization **at that pin**. Preserve IDs; this remains a separate app follow-up, not a current-device assertion or authoring stop.

The four successful author-run outputs are structural evidence only. No new native/device, media, C6/C7, default-activation, release, full-corpus or native-speaker certification is issued.
